target_customer: Shopify and Amazon sellers and e-commerce brands that manufacture overseas
problem: E-commerce brands lose money to product quality problems from overseas suppliers and lack a dedicated quality control function.
business_model: SaaS with a free tier for monitoring product quality (paid pricing not found)

founders.name: Sajag Agarwal
previous_startups: A consumer brand with about $2M annual revenue (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: spent a year in China handling supply chain issues himself. Education not listed.

founders.name: Jake Corkin
founders.background_notes: YC page: led product and sales at Downstream and spent 5 years at Amazon. Downstream's acquisition is dated March 2021 by Preqin, CB Insights and PitchBook per search results.

founders.name: Rafael Petry
founders.background_notes: YC page lists the role only.

founders.name: Michael Friedman
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Monitoring product quality from marketplace reviews and seller data with AI and coordinating inspections is standard data engineering with some operations complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Seller data integrations and inspection networks are replicable, and established inspection vendors serve brands already.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents a copy or acquisition of Movley.

market_need_then: The company claimed 800+ brands used it. Founder Sajag Agarwal had run a consumer brand and managed supply chain issues in China himself.

branding.domain_note: movley.com now redirects to app.opsninja.com with a 301 redirect, so the domain points at another product. No source explains the transfer.

identity.voice_and_tone: Built by sellers, trusted by 800+ brands, per the tagline

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand was found. A brand guideline PDF with a similar spelling, Movely, could not be tied to this company.

outcome_analysis: Movley had a founding team with seller experience and about $1.7M reported seed funding in 2023 with a claimed 800+ brand user base, but the YC directory lists it inactive. The domain now redirects to app.opsninja.com, which hints at a change of ownership or product, but no source confirms an acquisition, rebrand or shutdown, so the cause is not public.
notes: Totals conflict: VCBacked and CB Insights say $1.7M (CB Insights over 2 rounds), Employbl lists a $1,335,000 pre-seed and total $3,035,000, FundedIQ says $4.6M over 3 rounds. Seed date is August 2023 per VCBacked and June 12, 2023 per CB Insights. Both recorded rounds rest on aggregators and the pre-seed amount rests on one database with no exact date. Movley.com redirects to app.opsninja.com; a 2015 OpsNinja article concerns different founders and is unrelated. No competitor source dated at or before the batch was opened, since inspection vendor pages found were undated aggregator pages. Competitors list empty for that reason. Exit type unknown.
